text:
Eli: Quick follow-up from the INC-2026-110 postmortem \u2014 consolidating owners for the alert-tuning sprint (noise pruning, thresholds, dedupe rules, paging policies). Drop your commitments here.
PolicyBot: Incident INC-2026-110 archived at 2026-04-12T07:14:22Z. Postmortem: /incidents/INC-2026-110.
Nora: I'll take the noise-pruning sweep and candidate suppression list. Plan: 21-day backtest, dry-run first. ETA: Thu EOD.
Chen: I'll own thresholds and the 24h canary dashboard. Need to calculate p95/p99 and week-over-week spikes. Will post SQL + graphs tomorrow AM.
Samir: Paging & rota changes are on me. Proposal: create a `night-low-touch` route 00:00-06:00 and apply a 12m coalesce window for identical alerts. Also exclude `ci-*` namespaces.
Eli: Please tag PRs with label `pm-followup/INC-2026-110` and add runbook snippets for support. I'll consolidate. Target: PRs open by 2026-04-17.
Nora: Draft suppression rule (dry-run):
```
# suppress repeated http 502s from same host
if count(error: "http_502", host) > 10/min then suppress for 30m
```
Nora: Running a dry-run now to estimate false-suppression. Will post results here.
Chen: Threshold plan:
- collect rolling 30d p95/p99 for `inference.latency_ms` and `service.error_rate`
- propose new alert thresholds where p99 > 1.5x baseline OR p95 > 700ms
I'll post queries & charts by 09:30 PT.
Samir: For paging, I'll add a regex filter to the router: `^ci-|^test-` to skip paging. Also will create a canary route to test before wide rollout.
Eli: Ownership matrix: noise = Nora, thresholds = Chen, paging = Samir, PM = Eli. Sequence: 1) Nora: suppression dry-run (Thu EOD) 2) Chen: threshold analysis + canary (tomorrow 09:30 PT) 3) Samir: paging config + canary route (Mon) 4) Eli: merge coordination + rollout doc (by Fri).
Chen: Quick question \u2014 should suppression be blocked for alerts flagged as "recurring" by the recurrence detector? I can prototype a recurrence score but need confirmation on the cutoff.
Nora: Yes, prefer long-term fix for recurring signals. Suggest recurrence cutoff: >5 occurrences in 30d AND pattern_score > 0.6. If flagged, route to engineering backlog instead of suppression.
Samir: I'll add the recurrence list to the weekly ops dashboard so we can prioritize engineering tickets.
Eli: Also let's add a short rollback policy: if after rollout the global alert volume increases >10% in 24h, auto-revert the change. Add that to each PR's checklist.
Nora: Dry-run results: the naive suppression would affect ~14 alerts/day; false-suppression risk ~1.8% on sampled traces. Posting CSV to the draft PR.
Chen: SQL & graphs posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/612 (WIP). Proposed thresholds attached.
Samir: Branch `night-route-exclude` created and canary route wired. Will open PR with tests by Mon.
Eli: Great. React with :white_check_mark: when PRs are up. I'll update the follow-up tracker and schedule a 20m post-rollout check.
Nora: :white_check_mark: PR draft created and labeled.
Chen: :white_check_mark: threshold PR (draft) up.
Samir: :white_check_mark: paging canary branch pushed, PR tomorrow.
Eli: If anyone hits blockers (data perms, runbook gaps), call it out here and we'll reassign.
PolicyBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up-sync (INC-2026-110) on 2026-04-20T16:00:00Z.
Eli: Closing for now \u2014 I'll post the consolidated rollout plan once all PRs are ready.
